summary: Verified fix for 'QR no reconocido' bug on Picking screen (ScanHarvestMode). Backend sanity: /api/workers returns 3 workers with AGW-XXXXXXXXXX qr_code, POST /api/parcels and /api/products accept {name}-only payloads (auto-fill defaults). Frontend sanity: login → /registrar?mode=qr&parcel=&product= shows session banner, paymode toggle (piece/hour), scanner card with manual-add fallback. Normalization logic (normalizeCode + extractCode + workersByQr map) correctly resolves all QR variants: exact, lowercase, trimmed, URL-prefixed (agriscan://worker/AGW-xxx), https://x/w/agw-xxx, scheme:CODE, and MongoDB _id fallback. Manual-add dropdown increments tally (1→2) and 'scan-save-button' triggers POST /api/harvests then navigates to /dia. Paymode switch piece↔hour toggles UI correctly. All tested data-testids present and functional.

minor.issue: Server-side worker lookup is case-sensitive and does NOT handle URL-prefixed codes. 'agw-5e8a55913a' and 'agriscan://worker/AGW-...' both return 404. Only exact match works. Picking is unaffected (client-side lookup is normalized), but the Asistencia Check-in orange flow still has this limitation.

action_items: Optional: mirror the Picking normalization fix on backend _resolve_worker_by_code (around server.py:891) — uppercase the stored qr_code and incoming code, strip URL/scheme prefix — so Asistencia Check-in also tolerates lowercase/URL-wrapped QR payloads.
critical_code_review_comments: ScanHarvestMode.jsx: workersByQr map now built with normalizeCode(qr_code|id|document_id) — case-insensitive, trimmed, handles URL/scheme prefix via extractCode. Verified via live browser evaluation.
handleScan correctly reports the DECODED code in the error toast (slice 0..24) rather than the raw QR payload — easier debugging.
Backend _resolve_worker_by_code still does case-sensitive db.workers.find_one({'qr_code': code}); not aligned with the frontend normalization. Low priority since Picking is client-side.
File ScanHarvestMode.jsx is 763 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting the Pay-by-hour sub-view.
